title: Sherpa-UI page definition
description: One page, as JSON: its data source and its components' configuration. Its markup is its Context's, in app.v1.json. The provider's open() reads it. docs/PAGE-DEFINITION.md

id.description: The page's id: its Views, its saved Views and its kept Query are filed under it.

ui.description: Each component's configuration, by id, set through its own API before it is answered — as a View's ui is.

savedFilters.description: The page's own saved filters, by id: listed beside a reader's, and applied as theirs are.

store.description: The name the app registered its store under.

applyOn.description: change: a filter applies once per act. input: LIVE, while its value moves, debounce ms after the last move. A remote source always waits for Apply.

debounce.description: How long a live filter waits after the last move, in ms. Default 300.

holdRows.description: A remote store's whole set is held up to this many rows, and every question is answered from it on the client. 0 holds none. Default 50 000.

search.description: The fields a free-text search looks at.

fields.description: Every field a filter may ask of. No field lists its values: the store's schema says them, or the rows do.

axes.description: What each axis's chip offers in every scope: a scope's own axes win an axis over it.

advanced.description: Advanced conditions beside its values (true), or instead of them ("only").

op.description: The condition its filter opens on.

range.description: A date whose menus pick two ends, from and to. Left out, they pick days.

description.description: What the field is, in a few words: its filter chip's tip says it, where the page shows tips in lines.

section.description: The named section its chip sits in, where a bar heads its sections (a portrait one). Chips of one section sit together under its name; a chip with none is a section of its own, named for it.

labels.description: A value's name as a reader sees it, where it is not the value.

carryOver.description: Its answer survives a View change that does not answer it; without this, a View resets it.

child.description: The field holding this one's CHILD values — a Customer's Site. A child has no filter of its own: its picks are in this field's reading.

fetch.description: server: its filter is asked of the store, never worked out from the rows held — once per answer, for the keys it matches. Its menus have Apply.

start.description: What a fetching list — one in the View, or any on a remote source — opens on: first, its first value (the default), or all, no filter.

axes.description: What each axis's chip offers in this scope, over the page's.

offers.description: Every field it may add, or "all" for every field the page declares.

holds.description: The fields it holds at the start.

where.description: Its answers at the start, field by field, as a View writes them: { "created": { "last": 12, "unit": "month" } }. Reset puts them back.

arranges.description: Group and Sort arrange its rows: its Organise chips. Left out, a scope a page of rows is drawn in does, and the View does not.

presets.description: The app's own named conditions, each a boolean chip leading the scope, its where in the plain form.

presentation.description: What its slot shows until the reader changes it: its kind, its primary (the first split: a bar, a slice or a grid's pinned column a value), its secondary (a bar chart's stack: its colours and legend) and its group (the sections in each).

grid.description: Its grid's own default, over the slot's: a grid's Primary is its pinned first column.

chart.description: Its charts' own default, over the slot's.

sets.description: Fields drawn as one group. A serial set chains them: each offers only what the answers of the fields above it leave.

mode.description: parallel, the default, only groups them.

fields.description: In order: in a serial set, the order is the chain.

axes.description: The fields each axis's chip offers — primary, secondary, group — and per view, grid and chart, over them. The last to name an axis wins it whole.

axisOffers.description: The fields each axis's chip offers in one view.

axisOffer.description: One axis's fields: only those available, less those unavailable. It narrows, never adds: never a number or a date.

view.description: A view's default presentation: its Primary, Secondary, Group and order.

savedFilter.description: A saved filter: a name, and each scope's filters as a View writes them. Applied, it fills the field chips.

scopes.description: Each scope it fills, by id. A scope it does not name has no filters once it is applied.

condition.description: One field's condition: the plain form of a condition tree, parsed once. Several ops all hold; and and or take a list, nested as deep as they say; numbers as numbers.

last.description: A date in the last n units, from today.

next.description: A date in the next n units, from today.

all.description: Every value, on purpose: Select all on, which filters nothing.
